# Scripted effects take no parameters in 1.19.4.1 (decision E1): a call sets zin_arg_<name> temporary variables first.
# bloc: volcano 1, iron 2, war 3, warrens 4; kind: march 1, hold 2, corsair 3; strait: north 1, south 2; target: bordering -1, holds -2;
# answer: beacons 1, blood-price 2, in kind 3; result: won 1, lost 2, cancelled 3.

zin_dark_add_border_tension = {
	add_to_variable = { global.zin_dark_border_tension = zin_arg_value }
	clamp_variable = { var = global.zin_dark_border_tension min = 0 max = 100 }
}

zin_dark_refresh_shield = {
	every_country = {
		limit = { zin_dark_is_accord_member = yes }
		set_variable = { zin_dark_shield_def = global.zin_dark_accord_resolve }
		multiply_variable = { zin_dark_shield_def = 0.001 }
		set_variable = { zin_dark_shield_core = global.zin_dark_accord_resolve }
		multiply_variable = { zin_dark_shield_core = 0.001 }
		set_variable = { zin_dark_shield_ws = global.zin_dark_accord_resolve }
		multiply_variable = { zin_dark_shield_ws = 0.0005 }
		add_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = zin_dark_accord_shield }
		force_update_dynamic_modifier = yes
	}
	every_country = {
		limit = {
			zin_dark_is_accord_member = no
			has_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = zin_dark_accord_shield }
		}
		remove_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = zin_dark_accord_shield }
	}
}

zin_dark_add_accord_resolve = {
	add_to_variable = { global.zin_dark_accord_resolve = zin_arg_value }
	clamp_variable = { var = global.zin_dark_accord_resolve min = 0 max = 100 }
	zin_dark_refresh_shield = yes
}

zin_goldoroth_refresh_temper = {
	if = {
		limit = {
			check_variable = { zin_goldoroth_temper > 69.99 }
			NOT = { has_idea = zin_dark_restless_clans }
		}
		add_ideas = zin_dark_restless_clans
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			check_variable = { zin_goldoroth_temper < 60 }
			has_idea = zin_dark_restless_clans
		}
		remove_ideas = zin_dark_restless_clans
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			check_variable = { zin_goldoroth_temper < 25.01 }
			NOT = { has_idea = zin_dark_settled_hearths }
		}
		add_ideas = zin_dark_settled_hearths
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			check_variable = { zin_goldoroth_temper > 35 }
			has_idea = zin_dark_settled_hearths
		}
		remove_ideas = zin_dark_settled_hearths
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			check_variable = { zin_goldoroth_temper > 69.99 }
			NOT = { has_country_flag = zin_goldoroth_temper_70 }
		}
		set_country_flag = zin_goldoroth_temper_70
		country_event = { id = zin_dark.43 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { zin_goldoroth_temper < 60 } }
		clr_country_flag = zin_goldoroth_temper_70
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			check_variable = { zin_goldoroth_temper > 89.99 }
			NOT = { has_country_flag = zin_goldoroth_temper_90 }
		}
		set_country_flag = zin_goldoroth_temper_90
		country_event = { id = zin_dark.42 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { zin_goldoroth_temper < 80 } }
		clr_country_flag = zin_goldoroth_temper_90
	}
}

zin_goldoroth_apply_sway = {
	set_temp_variable = { zin_dark_gain = zin_arg_value }
	if = {
		limit = {
			check_variable = { zin_dark_gain > 0 }
			OR = {
				check_variable = { zin_volgan_pact = 2 }
				has_country_flag = zin_dark_moot_member
			}
		}
		multiply_temp_variable = { zin_dark_gain = 0.5 }
	}
	add_to_variable = { zin_goldoroth_sway = zin_dark_gain }
	clamp_variable = { var = zin_goldoroth_sway min = 0 max = 100 }
	if = {
		limit = {
			zin_dark_is_accord_member = yes
			check_variable = { zin_goldoroth_sway > 30 }
		}
		set_variable = { zin_goldoroth_sway = 30 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			check_variable = { zin_volgan_pact > 2.99 }
			check_variable = { zin_goldoroth_sway > 20 }
		}
		set_variable = { zin_goldoroth_sway = 20 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			original_tag = BLK
			check_variable = { zin_goldoroth_sway > 40 }
		}
		set_variable = { zin_goldoroth_sway = 40 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			original_tag = DND
			check_variable = { zin_goldoroth_sway > 0 }
		}
		set_variable = { zin_goldoroth_sway = 0 }
	}
}

zin_goldoroth_add_sway = {
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { zin_arg_target = -1 } }
		every_country = {
			limit = {
				zin_dark_is_free_hold = yes
				is_neighbor_of = GOL
			}
			zin_goldoroth_apply_sway = yes
		}
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { zin_arg_target = -2 } }
		every_country = {
			limit = { zin_dark_is_free_hold = yes }
			zin_goldoroth_apply_sway = yes
		}
	}
	else = {
		var:zin_arg_target = { zin_goldoroth_apply_sway = yes }
	}
}

zin_goldoroth_yoke_check = {
	var:zin_arg_target = {
		if = {
			limit = {
				zin_dark_date_yoke = yes
				zin_dark_is_free_hold = yes
				is_in_faction = no
				NOT = { has_war_with = GOL }
				OR = {
					check_variable = { zin_goldoroth_sway > 49.99 }
					AND = {
						check_variable = { zin_goldoroth_sway > 39.99 }
						GOL = { has_country_flag = zin_goldoroth_yoke_cheap }
					}
				}
			}
			country_event = { id = zin_dark.50 }
		}
	}
}

zin_goldoroth_tribute_on_capitulation = {
	# on_capitulation: ROOT capitulates, FROM is the winner.
	if = {
		limit = {
			zin_dark_is_free_hold = yes
			FROM = {
				original_tag = GOL
				has_country_flag = zin_goldoroth_mercy
			}
		}
		FROM = {
			puppet = ROOT
			set_autonomy = { target = ROOT autonomy_state = zin_autonomy_tributary_hold end_wars = yes end_civil_wars = no }
		}
		set_variable = { zin_goldoroth_sway = 60 }
		set_variable = { zin_dark_tribute_days = 0 }
		add_ideas = zin_dark_tributary_hold
	}
}

zin_goldoroth_refresh_unity = {
	set_temp_variable = { zin_dark_held = 0 }
	every_state = {
		limit = {
			zin_is_region_dark_lands = yes
			owner = {
				OR = {
					original_tag = GOL
					is_subject_of = GOL
				}
			}
		}
		add_to_temp_variable = { zin_dark_held = 1 }
	}
	multiply_temp_variable = { zin_dark_held = 100 }
	divide_temp_variable = { zin_dark_held = global.zin_dark_states_total }
	GOL = {
		set_variable = { zin_goldoroth_unity = zin_dark_held }
		clamp_variable = { var = zin_goldoroth_unity min = 0 max = 100 }
		if = {
			limit = {
				check_variable = { zin_goldoroth_unity > 49.99 }
				NOT = { has_country_flag = zin_goldoroth_unity_50 }
			}
			set_country_flag = zin_goldoroth_unity_50
			news_event = { id = zin_dark.60 }
			set_temp_variable = { zin_arg_value = 10 }
			zin_dark_add_accord_resolve = yes
		}
	}
}

			GOL = { has_country_flag = zin_goldoroth_heir_volcano }
		}
		set_temp_variable = { zin_dark_heir = 1 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			check_variable = { zin_dark_heir = 0 }
			GOL = { has_country_flag = zin_goldoroth_heir_iron }
		}
		set_temp_variable = { zin_dark_heir = 2 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			check_variable = { zin_dark_heir = 0 }
			GOL = { has_country_flag = zin_goldoroth_heir_war }
		}
		set_temp_variable = { zin_dark_heir = 3 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			check_variable = { zin_dark_heir = 0 }
			GOL = { has_country_flag = zin_goldoroth_heir_warrens }
		}
		set_temp_variable = { zin_dark_heir = 4 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { zin_dark_heir = 0 } }
		set_temp_variable = { zin_dark_heir = global.zin_dark_challenger }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { zin_dark_heir > 0 } }
		GOL = {
			kill_country_leader = yes
			if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { zin_dark_heir = 1 } }

					character = zin_goldoroth_sungor
					promote_leader = yes
					country_leader = {
						ideology = zin_dom_conquest
						expire = "2000.1.1.1"
					}
				}
			}

				limit = { check_variable = { zin_dark_heir = 2 } }

					character = zin_goldoroth_bord

					country_leader = {
						ideology = zin_dom_conquest
						expire = "2000.1.1.1"

				}

		set_temp_variable = { zin_arg_bloc = 1 }

			limit = { check_variable = { zin_dark_heir = 1 } }
			set_temp_variable = { zin_arg_value = 25 }
		}
		else = {
			set_temp_variable = { zin_arg_value = -10 }

zin_goldoroth_warking_takes_field = {
	GOL = {
		random_character = {
			limit = { is_country_leader = yes }
			if = {
				limit = { is_field_marshal = no }
				add_field_marshal_role = {
					skill = 4
					attack_skill = 4
					defense_skill = 3
					planning_skill = 3
					logistics_skill = 3
				}
			}
			add_unit_leader_trait = zin_trait_black_iron_warlord
		}
	}
}

zin_goldoroth_proclaim_one_kingdom = {
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { GOL = { has_country_flag = zin_goldoroth_one_kingdom } } }
		GOL = {
			set_country_flag = zin_goldoroth_one_kingdom
			set_cosmetic_tag = zin_cosmetic_goldoroth_great
			add_stability = 0.1
			add_political_power = 100
		}
		set_temp_variable = { zin_arg_value = 3 }
		zin_world_add_gathering_dark = yes
		GOL = { news_event = { id = zin_dark.61 } }
	}
}

zin_goldoroth_kneel = {
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { GOL = { has_country_flag = zin_goldoroth_kneeled } } }
		GOL = {
			set_country_flag = zin_goldoroth_kneeled
			every_subject_country = {
				limit = {
					zin_dark_is_tributary = yes
					check_variable = { zin_goldoroth_sway > 59.99 }
				}
				PREV = { annex_country = { target = PREV } }
			}
			every_subject_country = {
				limit = { zin_dark_is_tributary = yes }
				PREV = { end_puppet = PREV }
				set_temp_variable = { zin_arg_value = -20 }
				zin_goldoroth_apply_sway = yes
			}
		}
		PUV = {
			puppet = GOL
			set_autonomy = { target = GOL autonomy_state = zin_autonomy_sworn_realm end_wars = yes end_civil_wars = no }
		}
		GOL = {
			set_politics = { ruling_party = communism elections_allowed = no }
			set_temp_variable = { zin_arg_stance = 12 }
			zin_politics_set_stance = yes
			add_ideas = zin_goldoroth_sworn_to_nafeher
		}
		set_temp_variable = { zin_arg_value = 5 }
		zin_volgan_add_dominion_strength = yes
		if = {
			limit = { NOT = { has_global_flag = zin_volgan_marches } }
			set_temp_variable = { zin_arg_value = -15 }
			zin_volgan_add_veil = yes
		}
		set_temp_variable = { zin_arg_value = 3 }
		zin_world_add_gathering_dark = yes
		GOL = { news_event = { id = zin_dark.62 } }
	}
}

zin_dark_add_volgan_pact = {
	var:zin_arg_target = {
		set_temp_variable = { zin_dark_pact_was = zin_volgan_pact }
		add_to_variable = { zin_volgan_pact = zin_arg_value }
		clamp_variable = { var = zin_volgan_pact min = 0 max = 3 }
		if = {
			limit = {
				check_variable = { zin_volgan_pact > 2.99 }
				check_variable = { zin_dark_pact_was < 2.99 }
			}
			set_variable = { zin_volgan_pact = 2 }
		}
	}
}

	}
}

zin_goldoroth_wargoal_defiant = {
	GOL = {
		every_country = {
			limit = {
				has_country_flag = zin_dark_refused_yoke
				NOT = { has_war_with = GOL }
				OR = {
					is_neighbor_of = GOL
					any_other_country = {
						is_subject_of = GOL
						is_neighbor_of = PREV
					}
				}
				OR = {
					has_global_flag = zin_war_of_last_crowns
					has_global_flag = zin_volgan_marches
					GOL = { has_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = zin_cb_hold_defiance scope = PREV } }
				}
			}
			GOL = { create_wargoal = { type = annex_everything target = PREV } }
		}
	}
}

zin_goldoroth_wargoal_sworn = {
	GOL = {
		every_country = {
			limit = {
				zin_dark_is_dark = yes
				NOT = { original_tag = GOL }
				check_variable = { zin_volgan_pact > 2.99 }
				NOT = { has_war_with = GOL }
				OR = {
					is_neighbor_of = GOL
					any_other_country = {
						is_subject_of = GOL
						is_neighbor_of = PREV
					}
				}
			}
			GOL = { create_wargoal = { type = annex_everything target = PREV } }
		}
	}
}

zin_goldoroth_wargoal_strait_south = {
	set_temp_variable = { zin_dark_goal_state = 0 }
	random_state = {
		limit = {
			zin_is_site_dark_strait_south_far = yes
			owner = {
				OR = {
					original_tag = AEN
					is_subject_of = AEN
				}
			}
		}
		set_temp_variable = { zin_dark_goal_state = THIS }
		set_temp_variable = { zin_dark_goal_owner = OWNER }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { zin_dark_goal_state > 0 } }
		GOL = {
			meta_effect = {
				text = {
					create_wargoal = {
						type = take_state
						target = var:zin_dark_goal_owner
						generator = { [STATE] }
					}
				}
				STATE = "[?zin_dark_goal_state|0]"
			}
		}
	}
}

zin_goldoroth_rally_free_dark = {
	every_country = {
		limit = {
			zin_dark_is_dark = yes
			NOT = { original_tag = GOL }
			check_variable = { zin_goldoroth_sway > 39.99 }
			check_variable = { zin_volgan_pact < 1.01 }
		}
		give_military_access = GOL
		add_opinion_modifier = { target = GOL modifier = zin_dark_gifts }
	}
}

zin_goldoroth_offer_access_against_dead = {
	every_country = {
		limit = {
			zin_dark_is_dark = yes
			NOT = { original_tag = GOL }
			has_war_with = ZOL
		}
		give_military_access = GOL
		GOL = { give_military_access = PREV }
	}
}

zin_dark_start_border_clash = {
	# The target is Dondor (section 2); the attacker's state is a march state that borders it.
	if = {
		limit = {
			zin_dark_date_war_floor = yes
			NOT = { has_global_flag = zin_dark_clash_active }
			country_exists = DND
		}
		GOL = {
			random_owned_state = {
				limit = {
					zin_is_site_goldoroth_march = yes
					any_neighbor_state = { is_owned_by = DND }
				}
				save_event_target_as = zin_dark_clash_a
				random_neighbor_state = {
					limit = { is_owned_by = DND }
					save_event_target_as = zin_dark_clash_b
				}
			}
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				has_event_target = zin_dark_clash_a
				has_event_target = zin_dark_clash_b
			}
			set_global_flag = zin_dark_clash_active
			GOL = {
				if = {
					limit = { has_global_flag = zin_war_of_last_crowns }
					start_border_war = {
						change_state_after_war = yes
						combat_width = 40
						minimum_duration_in_days = 21
						attacker = {
							state = event_target:zin_dark_clash_a
							num_provinces = 3
							on_win = zin_dark.2
							on_lose = zin_dark.3
							on_cancel = zin_dark.4
						}
						defender = {
							state = event_target:zin_dark_clash_b
							num_provinces = 3
							on_win = zin_dark.3
							on_lose = zin_dark.2
							on_cancel = zin_dark.4
						}
					}
				}
				else = {
					start_border_war = {
						change_state_after_war = no
						combat_width = 40
						minimum_duration_in_days = 21
						attacker = {
							state = event_target:zin_dark_clash_a
							num_provinces = 3
							on_win = zin_dark.2
							on_lose = zin_dark.3
							on_cancel = zin_dark.4
						}
						defender = {
							state = event_target:zin_dark_clash_b
							num_provinces = 3
							on_win = zin_dark.3
							on_lose = zin_dark.2
							on_cancel = zin_dark.4
						}
					}
				}
			}
			set_temp_variable = { zin_arg_value = 1 }
			zin_world_add_gathering_dark = yes
			GOL = { news_event = { id = zin_dark.15 } }
		}
	}
}

zin_dark_end_clash = {
	if = {
		limit = { has_global_flag = zin_dark_clash_active }
		clr_global_flag = zin_dark_clash_active
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { zin_arg_result = 1 } }
			GOL = { country_event = { id = zin_dark.16 } }
			DND = { country_event = { id = zin_dark.16 } }
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { zin_arg_result = 2 } }
			GOL = { country_event = { id = zin_dark.17 } }
			DND = { country_event = { id = zin_dark.17 } }
		}
		else = {
			GOL = { country_event = { id = zin_dark.18 } }
			DND = { country_event = { id = zin_dark.18 } }
		}
	}
}

zin_dark_blood_price_paid = {
	set_temp_variable = { zin_arg_value = -15 }
	zin_dark_add_border_tension = yes
	GOL = {
		if = {
			limit = { has_country_flag = zin_goldoroth_blood_price }
			add_political_power = 35
			set_temp_variable = { zin_arg_value = -5 }
			zin_goldoroth_add_temper = yes
		}
		else = { add_political_power = 25 }
		add_opinion_modifier = { target = PREV modifier = zin_dark_blood_price_paid }
	}
}

zin_dark_answer_raid = {
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { zin_arg_answer = 1 } }
		if = {
			limit = { zin_dark_is_accord_member = yes }
			set_temp_variable = { zin_arg_value = 3 }
			zin_dark_add_accord_resolve = yes
		}
		else = {
			add_opinion_modifier = { target = DND modifier = zin_dark_beacons_lit }
		}
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { zin_arg_answer = 2 } }
		add_political_power = -40
		zin_dark_blood_price_paid = yes
	}
	else = {
		add_war_support = 0.03
		set_temp_variable = { zin_arg_value = 5 }
		zin_dark_add_border_tension = yes
	}
}

zin_dark_resolve_raid = {
	# kind: march 1, hold 2, corsair 3; the target is zin_arg_target (Dondor for a march raid)
	if = {
		limit = { var:zin_arg_target = { zin_dark_is_accord_member = yes } }
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { global.zin_dark_raid_dark_added < 2.99 } }
			set_temp_variable = { zin_arg_value = 0.25 }
			zin_world_add_gathering_dark = yes
			add_to_variable = { global.zin_dark_raid_dark_added = 0.25 }
		}
		set_variable = { global.zin_dark_raid_quiet_until = global.num_days }
		add_to_variable = { global.zin_dark_raid_quiet_until = 90 }
	}
	GOL = { set_country_flag = { flag = zin_goldoroth_fed days = 90 } }
	var:zin_arg_target = { set_country_flag = { flag = zin_dark_raided_recently days = 365 } }
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { zin_arg_kind = 1 } }
		GOL = {
			add_equipment_to_stockpile = { type = zin_arms_equipment amount = 150 }
			army_experience = 10
			set_temp_variable = { zin_arg_value = -8 }
			zin_goldoroth_add_temper = yes
			set_temp_variable = { zin_arg_bloc = 3 }
			set_temp_variable = { zin_arg_value = 5 }
			zin_goldoroth_add_favour = yes
		}
		set_temp_variable = { zin_arg_value = 8 }
		zin_dark_add_border_tension = yes
		var:zin_arg_target = { country_event = { id = zin_dark.11 } }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { zin_arg_kind = 2 } }
		GOL = {
			add_equipment_to_stockpile = { type = zin_arms_equipment amount = 100 }
			set_temp_variable = { zin_arg_value = -5 }
			zin_goldoroth_add_temper = yes
		}
		var:zin_arg_target = {
			add_opinion_modifier = { target = GOL modifier = zin_dark_raided }
			set_temp_variable = { zin_dark_theirs = num_divisions }
		}
		multiply_temp_variable = { zin_dark_theirs = 3 }
		GOL = {
			if = {
				limit = { NOT = { check_variable = { num_divisions < zin_dark_theirs } } }
				set_temp_variable = { zin_arg_value = 5 }
			}
			else = { set_temp_variable = { zin_arg_value = -5 } }
		}
		var:zin_arg_target = { zin_goldoroth_apply_sway = yes }
		set_temp_variable = { zin_arg_value = 2 }
		zin_dark_add_border_tension = yes
		var:zin_arg_target = { country_event = { id = zin_dark.12 } }
	}
	else = {
		GOL = {
			add_equipment_to_stockpile = { type = zin_arms_equipment amount = 100 }
			add_political_power = 25
			set_temp_variable = { zin_arg_value = -5 }
			zin_goldoroth_add_temper = yes
		}
		var:zin_arg_target = {
			if = {
				limit = { zin_dark_is_accord_member = yes }
				set_temp_variable = { zin_arg_value = 6 }
				zin_dark_add_border_tension = yes
			}
			if = {
				limit = { original_tag = BLK }
				LER = { add_opinion_modifier = { target = GOL modifier = zin_dark_corsair_outrage } }
			}
			country_event = { id = zin_dark.13 }
		}
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			var:zin_arg_target = { zin_dark_is_accord_member = yes }
			check_variable = { global.zin_gathering_dark > 24.99 }
			check_variable = { global.zin_dark_border_tension > 59.99 }
		}
		zin_dark_grant_raid_cb = yes
	}
	GOL = { country_event = { id = zin_dark.10 } }
}

zin_dark_startup = {
	set_variable = { global.zin_dark_border_tension = 35 }
	set_variable = { global.zin_dark_accord_resolve = 40 }
	set_variable = { global.zin_dark_raid_dark_added = 0 }
	set_variable = { global.zin_dark_raid_quiet_until = 0 }
	set_variable = { global.zin_dark_challenger = 0 }
	set_variable = { global.zin_dark_states_total = 89 }
	set_variable = { global.zin_dark_rule_roll = 0 }
	if = {
		limit = { zin_rules_ai_random_goldoroth = yes }
		random_list = {
			50 = { set_variable = { global.zin_dark_rule_roll = 1 } }
			50 = { set_variable = { global.zin_dark_rule_roll = 2 } }
		}
	}
	GOL = {
		set_variable = { zin_goldoroth_temper = 55 }
		set_variable = { zin_goldoroth_favour_volcano = 55 }
		set_variable = { zin_goldoroth_favour_iron = 50 }
		set_variable = { zin_goldoroth_favour_war = 60 }
		set_variable = { zin_goldoroth_favour_warrens = 35 }
		set_variable = { zin_goldoroth_unity = 0 }
		add_ideas = zin_goldoroth_quarrelsome_clans
		if = { limit = { NOT = { has_character = zin_goldoroth_bredo } } zin_goldoroth_bredo = { set_nationality = PREV } } if = { limit = { NOT = { has_global_flag = zin_in_play_goldoroth_bredo } } set_global_flag = zin_in_play_goldoroth_bredo add_advisor_role = { character = zin_goldoroth_bredo advisor = { slot = theorist idea_token = zin_goldoroth_bredo allowed = { original_tag = GOL } traits = { zin_adv_sage } cost = 100 } } }
		if = { limit = { NOT = { has_character = zin_goldoroth_sungor } } zin_goldoroth_sungor = { set_nationality = PREV } } if = { limit = { NOT = { has_global_flag = zin_in_play_goldoroth_sungor } } set_global_flag = zin_in_play_goldoroth_sungor add_advisor_role = { character = zin_goldoroth_sungor advisor = { slot = political_advisor idea_token = zin_goldoroth_sungor allowed = { original_tag = GOL } traits = { zin_adv_war_speaker } cost = 100 } } }
		if = { limit = { NOT = { has_character = zin_goldoroth_bord } } zin_goldoroth_bord = { set_nationality = PREV } } if = { limit = { NOT = { has_global_flag = zin_in_play_goldoroth_bord } } set_global_flag = zin_in_play_goldoroth_bord add_advisor_role = { character = zin_goldoroth_bord advisor = { slot = political_advisor idea_token = zin_goldoroth_bord allowed = { original_tag = GOL } traits = { zin_trait_forge_mistress } cost = 100 } } }
		if = { limit = { NOT = { has_character = zin_goldoroth_britag } } zin_goldoroth_britag = { set_nationality = PREV } } if = { limit = { NOT = { has_global_flag = zin_in_play_goldoroth_britag } } set_global_flag = zin_in_play_goldoroth_britag add_field_marshal_role = { character = zin_goldoroth_britag traits = { offensive_doctrine } skill = 4 attack_skill = 4 defense_skill = 3 planning_skill = 3 logistics_skill = 3 } }
		if = { limit = { NOT = { has_character = zin_goldoroth_snikkit } } zin_goldoroth_snikkit = { set_nationality = PREV } } if = { limit = { NOT = { has_global_flag = zin_in_play_goldoroth_snikkit } } set_global_flag = zin_in_play_goldoroth_snikkit add_corps_commander_role = { character = zin_goldoroth_snikkit traits = { trickster } skill = 2 attack_skill = 2 defense_skill = 2 planning_skill = 3 logistics_skill = 2 } }
	}
	DND = {
		set_variable = { zin_goldoroth_sway = 0 }
		set_variable = { zin_goldoroth_sway_start = zin_goldoroth_sway }
		set_variable = { zin_dark_tribute_days = 0 }
		set_variable = { zin_dark_moot_refusals = 0 }
	}
	DRK = {
		set_variable = { zin_goldoroth_sway = 20 }
		if = {
			limit = { is_neighbor_of = GOL }
			add_to_variable = { zin_goldoroth_sway = 10 }
		}
		set_variable = { zin_goldoroth_sway_start = zin_goldoroth_sway }
		set_variable = { zin_dark_tribute_days = 0 }
		set_variable = { zin_dark_moot_refusals = 0 }
	}
	BUN = {
		set_variable = { zin_goldoroth_sway = 20 }
		if = {
			limit = { is_neighbor_of = GOL }
			add_to_variable = { zin_goldoroth_sway = 10 }
		}
		set_variable = { zin_goldoroth_sway_start = zin_goldoroth_sway }
		set_variable = { zin_dark_tribute_days = 0 }
		set_variable = { zin_dark_moot_refusals = 0 }
	}
	VES = {
		set_variable = { zin_goldoroth_sway = 20 }
		if = {
			limit = { is_neighbor_of = GOL }
			add_to_variable = { zin_goldoroth_sway = 10 }
		}
		set_variable = { zin_goldoroth_sway_start = zin_goldoroth_sway }
		set_variable = { zin_dark_tribute_days = 0 }

zin_dark_refresh_panel_rows = {
	# The rows of the Horde and Accord windows: every sway-bearing Dark Lands country, and the Accord's members.
	clear_array = global.zin_dark_sway_rows
	clear_array = global.zin_dark_accord_rows
	every_country = {
		limit = {
			zin_dark_is_dark = yes
			NOT = { original_tag = GOL }
			NOT = { original_tag = DND }
		}
		add_to_array = { array = global.zin_dark_sway_rows value = THIS }
	}
	every_country = {
		limit = { zin_dark_is_accord_member = yes }
		add_to_array = { array = global.zin_dark_accord_rows value = THIS }
	}
	# the meters and the page of rows of an open Horde or Accord window (modules/mech_dark_panels.mjs)
	every_country = {
		limit = {
			OR = {
				has_country_flag = zin_ui_horde_open
				has_country_flag = zin_ui_accord_open
			}
		}
		zin_dark_ui_meters = yes
	}
}

zin_dark_on_zol_rising = {
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { has_global_flag = zin_dark_shore_warned } }
		set_global_flag = zin_dark_shore_warned
		every_country = {
			limit = {
				zin_dark_is_dark = yes
				OR = {
					any_owned_state = { zin_is_site_dark_strait_north_shore = yes }
					any_owned_state = { zin_is_site_ocean_of_zol_coast = yes }
				}
			}
			country_event = { id = zin_dark.80 }
		}
	}
}

zin_dark_on_body_destroyed = {
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { has_global_flag = zin_dark_south_silent } }
		set_global_flag = zin_dark_south_silent
		every_country = {
			limit = {
				zin_dark_is_dark = yes
				OR = {
					has_country_flag = zin_dark_was_sworn
					is_subject_of = PUV
					check_variable = { zin_volgan_pact > 2.99 }
				}
			}
			country_event = { id = zin_dark.82 }
		}
	}
}

zin_dark_pulse = {
	# temper
	set_temp_variable = { zin_dark_temper_delta = 0 }
	GOL = {
		if = {
			limit = {
				has_war = no
				NOT = { has_country_flag = zin_goldoroth_fed }
			}
			add_to_temp_variable = { zin_dark_temper_delta = 0.6 }
		}
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { zin_goldoroth_favour_war > 69.99 } }
			add_to_temp_variable = { zin_dark_temper_delta = 0.3 }
		}
		if = {
			limit = { has_country_flag = zin_goldoroth_ash_rites }
			add_to_temp_variable = { zin_dark_temper_delta = -0.2 }
		}
		if = {
			limit = { has_war = yes }
			add_to_temp_variable = { zin_dark_temper_delta = -1.5 }
		}
		if = {
			limit = { NOT = { has_idea = zin_goldoroth_warrens_heard } }
			add_to_variable = { zin_goldoroth_favour_warrens = -0.3 }
			clamp_variable = { var = zin_goldoroth_favour_warrens min = 0 max = 100 }
		}
		zin_goldoroth_refresh_favours = yes
	}
	set_temp_variable = { zin_arg_value = zin_dark_temper_delta }
	zin_goldoroth_add_temper = yes
	# the lowest bloc may challenge the Warking (once a year at most)
	GOL = {
		set_temp_variable = { zin_dark_lowest = 100 }
		set_temp_variable = { zin_dark_bloc_pick = 0 }
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { zin_goldoroth_favour_volcano < zin_dark_lowest } }
			set_temp_variable = { zin_dark_lowest = zin_goldoroth_favour_volcano }
			set_temp_variable = { zin_dark_bloc_pick = 1 }
		}
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { zin_goldoroth_favour_iron < zin_dark_lowest } }
			set_temp_variable = { zin_dark_lowest = zin_goldoroth_favour_iron }
			set_temp_variable = { zin_dark_bloc_pick = 2 }
		}
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { zin_goldoroth_favour_war < zin_dark_lowest } }
			set_temp_variable = { zin_dark_lowest = zin_goldoroth_favour_war }
			set_temp_variable = { zin_dark_bloc_pick = 3 }
		}
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { zin_goldoroth_favour_warrens < zin_dark_lowest } }
			set_temp_variable = { zin_dark_lowest = zin_goldoroth_favour_warrens }
			set_temp_variable = { zin_dark_bloc_pick = 4 }
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				check_variable = { zin_dark_lowest < 10.01 }
				zin_dark_date_war_floor = yes
				has_war = no
				NOT = { has_country_flag = zin_goldoroth_master_of_clans }
				NOT = { has_country_flag = zin_goldoroth_challenged }
			}
			set_country_flag = { flag = zin_goldoroth_challenged days = 365 }
			set_variable = { global.zin_dark_challenger = zin_dark_bloc_pick }
			country_event = { id = zin_dark.44 }
		}
	}
	# sway drift and the yoke
	every_country = {
		limit = {
			zin_dark_is_dark = yes
			NOT = { original_tag = GOL }
			has_variable = zin_goldoroth_sway
		}
		if = {
			limit = { zin_dark_is_tributary = yes }
			if = {
				limit = { GOL = { has_country_flag = zin_goldoroth_light_yoke } }
				add_to_variable = { zin_goldoroth_sway = 0.5 }
			}
			else = { add_to_variable = { zin_goldoroth_sway = 0.25 } }
			add_to_variable = { zin_dark_tribute_days = 30 }
			clamp_variable = { var = zin_goldoroth_sway min = 0 max = 100 }
		}
		else = {
			if = {
				limit = { has_idea = zin_dark_tributary_hold }
				remove_ideas = zin_dark_tributary_hold
				set_temp_variable = { zin_arg_value = -30 }
				zin_goldoroth_apply_sway = yes
			}
			set_temp_variable = { zin_dark_floor = zin_goldoroth_sway_start }
			subtract_from_temp_variable = { zin_dark_floor = 10 }
			if = {
				limit = {
					is_subject = no
					check_variable = { zin_goldoroth_sway > zin_dark_floor }
					check_variable = { zin_goldoroth_sway > 0.25 }
				}
				add_to_variable = { zin_goldoroth_sway = -0.25 }
			}
		}
		# remembered for zin_dark.82: who was sworn to the south before its fall
		if = {
			limit = {
				NOT = { has_global_flag = zin_volgan_body_destroyed }
				OR = {
					check_variable = { zin_volgan_pact > 2.99 }
					is_subject_of = PUV
				}
			}
			set_country_flag = zin_dark_was_sworn
		}
	}
	zin_goldoroth_refresh_unity = yes
	# tension and the Accord's resolve
	if = {
		limit = {
			check_variable = { global.zin_dark_border_tension > 30 }
			check_variable = { global.num_days > global.zin_dark_raid_quiet_until }
		}
		set_temp_variable = { zin_arg_value = -0.5 }
		zin_dark_add_border_tension = yes
	}
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { global.zin_gathering_dark > 39.99 } }
		set_temp_variable = { zin_arg_value = 0.5 }
		zin_dark_add_border_tension = yes
	}
	set_temp_variable = { zin_dark_resolve_delta = 0 }
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { global.zin_dark_border_tension > 59.99 } }
		add_to_temp_variable = { zin_dark_resolve_delta = 0.3 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { global.zin_dark_border_tension < 30 } }
		add_to_temp_variable = { zin_dark_resolve_delta = -0.2 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			any_country = {
				zin_dark_is_accord_member = yes
				has_war_with = GOL
			}
		}
		add_to_temp_variable = { zin_dark_resolve_delta = 0.5 }
	}
	set_temp_variable = { zin_dark_members = 0 }
	every_country = {
		limit = { zin_dark_is_accord_member = yes }
		add_to_temp_variable = { zin_dark_members = 1 }
	}
	set_variable = { global.zin_dark_member_count = zin_dark_members }
	subtract_from_temp_variable = { zin_dark_members = 2 }
	clamp_temp_variable = { var = zin_dark_members min = 0 max = 3 }
	multiply_temp_variable = { zin_dark_members = 0.2 }
	add_to_temp_variable = { zin_dark_resolve_delta = zin_dark_members }
	set_temp_variable = { zin_arg_value = zin_dark_resolve_delta }
	zin_dark_add_accord_resolve = yes
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { global.zin_dark_accord_resolve > 59.99 } }
		set_global_flag = zin_dark_accord_holds
	}
	else = { clr_global_flag = zin_dark_accord_holds }
	if = {
		limit = {
			check_variable = { global.zin_dark_accord_resolve < 20 }
			NOT = { has_global_flag = zin_dark_fray_sent }
		}
		set_global_flag = zin_dark_fray_sent
		every_country = {
			limit = {
				zin_dark_is_accord_member = yes
				is_faction_leader = no
			}
			country_event = { id = zin_dark.22 }
		}
	}
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { global.zin_dark_accord_resolve > 30 } }
		clr_global_flag = zin_dark_fray_sent
	}
	# mastery of the Sea of Darkness: the highest sum of naval bases on its coast, at least 4 and 1.5 times the next
	every_country = {
		limit = {
			OR = {
				has_variable = zin_dark_sea_bases
				any_owned_state = { zin_is_site_sea_of_darkness_coast = yes }
			}
		}
		set_variable = { zin_dark_sea_bases = 0 }
		every_owned_state = {
			limit = { zin_is_site_sea_of_darkness_coast = yes }
			add_to_variable = { PREV.zin_dark_sea_bases = building_level@naval_base }
		}
		set_variable = { zin_dark_sea_bases_scaled = zin_dark_sea_bases }
		multiply_variable = { zin_dark_sea_bases_scaled = 1.5 }
	}
	set_temp_variable = { zin_dark_new_master = 0 }
	random_country = {
		limit = {
			has_variable = zin_dark_sea_bases
			check_variable = { zin_dark_sea_bases > 3.99 }
			NOT = {
				any_other_country = {
					has_variable = zin_dark_sea_bases_scaled
					check_variable = { zin_dark_sea_bases_scaled > PREV.zin_dark_sea_bases }
				}
			}
		}
		set_temp_variable = { zin_dark_new_master = THIS }
	}
	every_country = {
		limit = {
			has_country_flag = zin_dark_sea_master
			NOT = { check_variable = { zin_dark_new_master = THIS } }
		}
		clr_country_flag = zin_dark_sea_master
		remove_ideas = zin_dark_sea_master
	}
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { check_variable = { zin_dark_new_master = 0 } } }
		var:zin_dark_new_master = {
			if = {
				limit = { NOT = { has_country_flag = zin_dark_sea_master } }
				set_country_flag = zin_dark_sea_master
				add_ideas = zin_dark_sea_master
			}
		}
	}
	# the Free Moot
	if = {
		limit = { has_global_flag = zin_dark_free_moot }
		set_temp_variable = { zin_dark_moot_count = 0 }
		every_country = {
			limit = { has_country_flag = zin_dark_moot_member }
			add_to_temp_variable = { zin_dark_moot_count = 1 }
		}
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { zin_dark_moot_count < 2 } }
			every_country = {
				limit = { has_country_flag = zin_dark_moot_member }
				country_event = { id = zin_dark.72 }
			}
			clr_global_flag = zin_dark_free_moot
		}
	}
	# Volgan's envoys, the dead on the shore, the fall of the south
	GOL = {
		if = {
			limit = {
				OR = {
					check_variable = { zin_volgan_pact > 0.99 }
					PUV = { has_completed_focus = zin_volgan_goldoroth_question }
				}
			}
			set_country_flag = zin_goldoroth_envoy_heard
		}
	}
	if = {
		limit = { has_global_flag = zin_zol_rising }
		zin_dark_on_zol_rising = yes
	}
	if = {
		limit = { has_global_flag = zin_volgan_body_destroyed }
		zin_dark_on_body_destroyed = yes
	}
	zin_dark_refresh_panel_rows = yes
	# the Dark Lands trees read these values (E4)
	every_country = {
		limit = { zin_dark_is_dark = yes }
		mark_focus_tree_layout_dirty = yes
	}
}

zin_dark_found_free_moot = {
	if = {
		limit = {
			NOT = { has_global_flag = zin_dark_free_moot }
			zin_dark_moot_eligible = yes
		}
		set_global_flag = zin_dark_free_moot
		set_country_flag = zin_dark_moot_member
		add_ideas = zin_dark_free_moot
		every_country = {
			limit = {
				zin_dark_moot_eligible = yes
				NOT = { has_country_flag = zin_dark_moot_member }
			}
			country_event = { id = zin_dark.70 }
		}
	}
}

zin_dark_join_free_moot = {
	if = {
		limit = {
			has_global_flag = zin_dark_free_moot
			zin_dark_moot_eligible = yes
			NOT = { has_country_flag = zin_dark_moot_member }
		}
		every_country = {
			limit = { has_country_flag = zin_dark_moot_member }
			add_opinion_modifier = { target = PREV modifier = zin_dark_moot_kin }
			PREV = { add_opinion_modifier = { target = PREV modifier = zin_dark_moot_kin } }
		}
		set_country_flag = zin_dark_moot_member
		add_ideas = zin_dark_free_moot
	}
}

zin_dark_leave_free_moot = {
	if = {
		limit = { has_country_flag = zin_dark_moot_member }
		clr_country_flag = zin_dark_moot_member
		set_variable = { zin_dark_moot_refusals = 0 }
		if = {
			limit = { has_idea = zin_dark_free_moot }
			remove_ideas = zin_dark_free_moot
		}
		every_country = {
			limit = { has_country_flag = zin_dark_moot_member }
			remove_opinion_modifier = { target = PREV modifier = zin_dark_moot_kin }
			PREV = { remove_opinion_modifier = { target = PREV modifier = zin_dark_moot_kin } }
		}
	}
}

zin_dark_on_declare_war = {
	if = {
		limit = {
			FROM = { has_country_flag = zin_dark_moot_member }
			NOT = { has_country_flag = zin_dark_moot_member }
		}
		set_variable = { global.zin_dark_moot_victim = FROM }
		set_variable = { global.zin_dark_moot_attacker = ROOT }
		every_country = {
			limit = {
				has_country_flag = zin_dark_moot_member
				NOT = { tag = FROM }
				NOT = { has_war_with = ROOT }
			}
			country_event = { id = zin_dark.71 }
		}
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			OR = {
				zin_dark_is_dark = yes
				FROM = { zin_dark_is_dark = yes }
			}
		}
		zin_dark_refresh_shield = yes
	}
}

zin_dark_on_capitulation = {
	if = {
		limit = { zin_dark_is_accord_member = yes }
		set_temp_variable = { zin_arg_value = -15 }
		zin_dark_add_accord_resolve = yes
	}
	zin_goldoroth_tribute_on_capitulation = yes
}
